operations.description: List the projects the token's person can see, active unless status is archived or trashed, one page per call; next is the following page's URL, send its page, and a page without next is the last
Read one project by projectId, with its dock, which names the id of its message board, to-do set and other tools
List the active people on one project, one page per call; next is the following page's URL, send its page, and a page without next is the last
Read one message board by boardId, the id the project's dock names for message_board

List the messages of one message board, ordered by sort (created_at or updated_at) and direction (asc or desc), one page per call; next is the following page's URL, send its page, and a page without next is the last
Read one message by messageId, its subject and its content as HTML

List the comments on one recording, such as a message, a to-do or a to-do list, by its id as recordingId, one page per call; next is the following page's URL, send its page, and a page without next is the last
Read one comment by commentId, its content as HTML and the recording it is on as parent
Read one to-do set by todosetId, the id the project's dock names for todoset, with its to-do list count and completion
List the to-do lists of one to-do set, active unless status is archived or trashed, one page per call; next is the following page's URL, send its page, and a page without next is the last
Read one to-do list, or one group of a to-do list, by id

List the to-dos of one to-do list, pending ones unless completed is true, active unless status is archived or trashed, one page per call; next is the following page's URL, send its page, and a page without next is the last
Read one to-do by todoId, its content, assignees, due date and whether it is completed
